limitations: Read-only review of remaining axe color-contrast incomplete nodes on the synthetic current-state Enterprise Setup fixture.
A computed solid-color ratio is reported only when the relevant ancestry has opaque backgrounds, no group opacity, and no background-image or filter ambiguity.
This is not full-page WCAG conformance or backend authorization evidence.

DOM hit tests are sampled and omit pointer-events:none painting. Computed ratios describe CSS color pairs, not a pixel-level or full WCAG audit; axe incompletes remain in the original capture receipt.
method: Fresh axe scan of the existing current-state fixture at 1440×900 and390×844, light/dark. CSS colors are converted to 8-bit sRGB through a 1px canvas; the standard relative-luminance ratio is computed against opaque ancestor backgrounds. Nine DOM hit-test samples across each target identify topmost pointer-hit elements. No screenshots were recaptured.
